text:
Eli (Events): Heads-up 7: finalizing the registration flow for next Wed's webinar. Primary asks: local time display, clear recording consent, and an easy "share with colleague" path.
Harper (Growth): For APAC-friendly scheduling we'll offer two options on the form (local evening OR morning PST). Auto-detect timezone and show the best match.
Priya (Growth): Add template UTM: utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=launchbench_q2. Also include referral_code for partner tracking.
Noah (Ops): Zoom: cloud recording + transcript ON. Preference for third-party captions if vendor creds arrive; otherwise fallback to Zoom auto-captions. Retention 90 days.
Jules (Sales Ops): Sales needs the attendee dump within 10 minutes. Required columns: email, company, role, country, referral_code, utm_campaign, attended, watch_seconds, question_flag. If watch_seconds >= 600 OR question_flag==true -> tag as MQL.
Ivy (Content): Asset ask: master_edit.mp4, highlight_2m.mp4, clip_cta_45s.mp4, transcript.txt, captions.srt, social_snippets.md. Can Ops place SRT and manifest next to clips in S3?
Noah (Ops): Yes. We'll write a simple YAML manifest and SRT to s3://redwood/webinars/{{event_id}}/. Example manifest snippet:
```
event_id: launchbench-2026-03-25
master: s3://redwood/webinars/launchbench-2026/master.mp4
clips:
  - name: highlight_2m
    start: 00:05:12
    end: 00:07:12
  - name: cta_45s
    start: 00:28:30
    end: 00:29:15
srt: true
deliver_to: s3://redwood/webinar-assets/launchbench-2026/
```
Eli (Events): Consent line (legal-approved): "I consent to being recorded and to receiving follow-up materials from Redwood Inference." Keep it visible and not pre-checked.
Harper (Growth): For routing: real-time POST to /webhooks/webinar-events. Add HMAC header and idempotency key (event_id+email). Primary target HubSpot incoming webhook; fallback to Zapier if rate limits hit.
Jules (Sales Ops): HubSpot mapping ready on the doc. Also want a boolean 'send_to_sales' evaluated at ingest. If > 3 MQLs in 30m notify #sales. If > 15 create a pager in the sales ops channel.
Noah (Ops): Sample CSV payload we'll produce for the ingest pipeline (stringified in the webhook):
```
email,attended,watch_seconds,utm_campaign,referral_code,question_flag
alex@startco.com,true,754,launchbench_q2,PART123,false
```
Ivy (Content): Follow-up email draft: Subject "Thanks \t6 replay + highlights" Body: one short thank you, link to highlight clip, three CTAs: Watch replay / Talk to sales / Download brief. Add UTM tags to each CTA.
Priya (Growth): Add GA4 event for CTA clicks: event_name=webinar_cta_click, params: {cta_type, event_id, campaign}. Use dataLayer push.
Noah (Ops): Caption vendor note: we need credentials by Tue EOD. If not received, we'll fall back to Zoom auto-transcript and an internal QC pass. We'll output both SRT and a plain transcript.txt with UTF-8 encoding.
Ivy (Content): Content will QA a 3-minute caption sample within 24 hours and flag issues. Also will prepare three headline variations for social.
Jules (Sales Ops): Sales prep: 20-min briefing + top-10 Qs doc. I'll schedule the briefing when registrations hit 25.
Eli (Events): Reminders: 24h and 1h before in attendee timezone. Replay access window: 72h for APAC registrants. Add a "share with colleague" button on the confirmation page that fills a short message and tags the referral_code.
Harper (Growth): Small paid push for the evening slot: $400/day for 3 days. We'll test referral_code uplift.
TranscribeBot: Cloud recording started, meeting id 321-654-987.
Noah (Ops): Action list: push manifest to S3, implement webhook with HMAC and idempotency, emit sample payload to this channel when ready.
Eli (Events): Thanks all 7. If vendor creds aren't in by Tue EOD we switch to Zoom auto captions and Zapier fallback. Closing after the end-to-end test tomorrow at 11am PT. :white_check_mark:
